context: Evaluates correct implementation of the formatMetadataForPrompt function that combines image format, cloud provider metadata, and config-driven EXIF tags into a structured string for AI prompts. Tests field selection logic, label usage from config, array joining, and fallback messages.

checklist.name: Image format uppercased header
checklist.description: Output begins with 'Image Format: {FORMAT}' where FORMAT is the imageFormat argument converted to uppercase.

checklist.name: Provider section conditional
checklist.description: The provider metadata section is only included when the provider argument is truthy (not null/undefined).

checklist.name: Correct provider field mapping
checklist.description: Provider fields are mapped using the specific keys: name→'Original Filename', host→'Source Service', description→'Description', id→'Source ID'. No other provider keys are included.

checklist.name: Embedded tags use config
checklist.description: The function iterates config.tags and checks embedded[tag.key] for each tag, using tag.label as the display label.

checklist.name: Array values joined
checklist.description: When an embedded metadata value is an Array, it is converted to a string by joining elements with ', '.

checklist.name: No metadata fallback message
checklist.description: When no config tags match embedded metadata, the string 'No relevant embedded metadata was found in this image.' is appended.
